theorem_1.name: ONE_ANCHOR_P7_CHORD_FORCING_V1
theorem_1.scope: Any graph containing seven distinct roles B1,C1,B2,C2,X0,C3,B3 with exactly the six consecutive template edges and no nonconsecutive edge on those seven vertices.
theorem_1.statement: The seven roles induce P7. Therefore any P7-free graph realizing the six consecutive edges must contain at least one chord among the 15 nonconsecutive pairs.

detailed_logic: B-B chord: source-optional in the frozen T0 state and changes G[U], the dynamic hard core.
B-C chord: C is singleton residual Y0, so insertion is source-legal in isolation and changes whether B belongs to D_C, hence the selector neighborhood.
B-X0 chord: X0 has fixed color 4 and every frozen T0 B exact list is {1,4}; adding the edge removes color 4 from A(B), so the exact dynamic list changes.
C-X0 chord: the unique nonconsecutive pair is C1=z2 with B_C1={1,3,4}; adding x0c4 removes color 4 from the component base list.

C-C chord: each of the three pairs creates a Y0 edge with an explicit dynamic vertex adjacent to exactly one endpoint, violating source axiom (iv). Thus each is SOURCE_FORBIDDEN; it would also merge two residual components.

theorem_2.name: FROZEN_T0_ONE_ANCHOR_P7_SEMANTIC_CHORD_FORCING_V1
theorem_2.statement: In the frozen inverse-Golovach T0 annotation, P7-freeness cannot be restored by any single chord without either violating source axiom (iv) or changing at least one tracked semantic object among G[U], D_C, A(u), B_C/mu_C/MIN_BAD, or the residual-component partition.
proof_basis: ONE_ANCHOR_P7_CHORD_FORCING_V1 requires at least one of the 15 chords.
The complete 15-pair census classifies all 15 with no SEMANTICS_NEUTRAL case.
Three C-C candidates are source-forbidden; all 12 source-legal candidates change a tracked object.
theorem_2.firewall: Changing a tracked object does not by itself prove that extension existence changes. Such a chord is only a repair candidate after a separate exact-equivalence/reconstruction theorem.

color_mask_redundancy_firewall.statement: The endpoint-type map B-X0 -> LIST_CHANGING and C-X0 -> COMPONENT_BASE_LIST_CHANGING is not unconditional in arbitrary source states.
color_mask_redundancy_firewall.reason: If another same-color X0 neighbor already excludes f(X0) from A(B) or the relevant base list, adding an identity-level B-X0 or C-X0 edge can leave the color mask unchanged.
color_mask_redundancy_firewall.consequence: General C5B completeness requires color-annotated masks and identity-vs-color redundancy, not only role names.
color_mask_redundancy_firewall.frozen_T0: No such redundancy exists for the three B-X0 candidates or the one C-X0 candidate, so the frozen theorem is exact.

reason: A complete general source census cannot be certified from the role alphabet alone.
X0 may be mixed on a connected Y0 component because source axiom (iv) excludes X0 from its outside-vertex condition, so a generic C-X0 role needs representative/internal-list annotations.
Source types depend on the current seed and exact dynamic lists depend on color masks from S union X0.
Same-color X0 identity redundancy can make some identity-edge insertions color-mask neutral.
phase_B_general_census.required_next_step: Construct an explicit source-derived annotated-template generator before claiming PASS_FINITE_SEMANTIC_CHORD_GRAMMAR for all source-valid 7-role templates.

next_frontier.name: R5_B1B1C5B1_SOURCE_ANNOTATED_ROLE_GRAMMAR_GENERATOR_V1
next_frontier.target: Generate all declared dangerous 7-role templates from exact source annotations (partition role, seed type, exact color mask, X0 color, component representative/base-list data, complete/anticomplete incidence) and prove generator completeness before any global C5B theorem.
